domain: documentary categories with similar reporting process but no plausible event-to-event mechanism
description: administratif-labeled entries (routine administrative reporting, per R-O7's event_type categories) as a negative control against MEC-01 -- routine administration should show no self-exciting structure if MEC-01 is genuine and specific to conflict/diplomacy events
M_target_mechanism_absent_or_distinct: UNRESOLVED (requires R-O7 colonial-category mapping to confirm 'administratif' is a source-native, mechanism-irrelevant category rather than a project label conflating several source terms)
O_no_outcome_overlap: UNRESOLVED (requires confirming administratif-coded rows do not share outcome construction with conflict/diplomacy rows beyond the shared corpus)
design_note: Design only. Cannot be admitted until R-O7 colonial-category mapping exists; using 'administratif' as a control before that mapping risks exactly the naturalization-of-colonial-category error the governing instruction prohibits.

domain: source-volume bursts independent of event categories
description: compare temporal clustering of ALL coded events (any category) against the documented GM/CD volume-incorporation dates (project's own session records) -- if clustering aligns with incorporation dates regardless of category, this favors MEC-05 over MEC-01/02/09 for at least the aligned years
S_shared_observation_process: 1 (all categories share the same incorporation-history confound)
M_target_mechanism_absent_or_distinct: 1 (MEC-05 is by definition distinct from MEC-01/02/09 as an observational vs historical mechanism)
O_no_outcome_overlap: 1 (incorporation-date covariate is external to which category an event is coded as, though it is NOT external to the outcome count itself -- see WP-E7 C_m_overlap=1 finding)
P_provenance_complete: 1 (session-incorporation dates are this project's own documented record)
design_note: Design only. Admissible as a design (S=M=O=P=1), but execution requires constructing the incorporation-date covariate (WP-E7 ANNUAL_DIGITIZATION_OR_ACCESS_COVERAGE, already flagged circular for MODEL use) -- so this control may be used DESCRIPTIVELY only, never as a formal statistical test input, per the same C_m_overlap=1 restriction.

description: compare event timing against known GM/CD volume-internal compilation boundaries (distinct from project incorporation dates) as a control for MEC-14 vs MEC-05
M_target_mechanism_absent_or_distinct: 1 (MEC-14 is explicitly distinct from MEC-05 per the mechanism register)
O_no_outcome_overlap: UNRESOLVED (volume-internal compilation boundaries are not yet documented in this repository for any source family)
design_note: Design only. Requires WP-E3-style source-family metadata (compilation boundary dates) not currently held for any source family in HAWKES_V2_SOURCE_FAMILY_OPPORTUNITY_MAP.csv.

description: compare event timing against dominion_status administrative-period transition dates (separate schema) as a control for MEC-13
S_shared_observation_process: 1 (dominion_status covers the same forts/negeri as the event corpus)
O_no_outcome_overlap: UNRESOLVED (requires confirming dominion_status transitions are not themselves derived from the same coded-event outcome process -- plausible risk of circularity given both trace to the same underlying research program)
design_note: Design only. The join itself (dominion_status x event corpus) is schema work, not source retrieval, and could be DO_NOW_READ_ONLY in a future operation -- but the O_z (no outcome overlap) component must be checked first, since dominion_status was itself backfilled partly from the same project's own event coding (project_dominion_status_backfill memory).

description: compare clustering under the current deterministic-jitter regime against a hypothetical alternative jitter regime, as a control for MEC-08 (date heaping)
M_target_mechanism_absent_or_distinct: 1 (MEC-08 is specifically about date-handling artifacts, distinct from genuine excitation)
O_no_outcome_overlap: 1 (comparing two jitter regimes of the SAME dataset does not introduce new outcome-construction overlap beyond what already exists)
P_provenance_complete: 1 (both regimes are fully specified by this project's own jitter methodology, already documented)
design_note: Design only. This is the one negative control that could in principle be assessed without new source access (it compares two jitter schemes of already-coded dates) -- but doing so would require refitting under an alternative jitter scheme, which is PROHIBITED in this operation (fitting is not authorized). Recorded as feasible-in-principle for a future, separately authorized operation, not executed here.
